title: Explaining the ghosts: Feminist intersectional XAI and cartography as methods to account for invisible labour
reasoning: The paper is a position paper that proposes a feminist intersectional framework for Explainable AI (XAI) to account for invisible labor. While it extensively discusses feminist epistemology and mentions religion as one of several social categories in intersectional analysis, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics in AI systems.
